note: Lewis County MO parcels are only reachable through the Vanguard-hosted assessor search (lewis.missouriassessors.com), an HTML search form with no public ArcGIS REST service or file download. ArcGIS searches for Lewis County MO found no parcel FeatureServer/MapServer; MSDIS and neighbouring-county checks found none. Parcel polygons are otherwise sold by commercial vendors (Regrid, Acres, landrecords.us).
